question: Should the next Supply BL PR proceed with the incidents block, and who should be the F2 owner/reviewer recorded on the mother issue?
rationale: The BL skill requires owner validation and a reviewer for each block, while this mother issue currently names the first block as in progress but does not provide the full owner/reviewer handoff needed for an autonomous PR lane.

options.title: Proceed with incidents
options.body: Use the current `incidents — en curso (javier)` line as the next block and add the missing reviewer/validation owner before implementation.

options.title: Choose another Supply block
options.body: Keep the issue open but sponsor order-state-machine, lifecycle, suspicious-orders, reschedule-flow, or b2b-orders first instead.

options.title: Keep as tracking only
options.body: Do not queue implementation from this issue yet; use it only to coordinate human-owned block PRs.

recommendation.title: Proceed with incidents
recommendation.body: Use the current `incidents — en curso (javier)` line as the next block and add the missing reviewer/validation owner before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Javier authored the mother issue and the BL skill commits that define this workflow, and the checklist already names Javier on the incidents block.
